job:
PRODUCT DESIGNER

About the Role
We're looking for a talented Product Designer to join our growing design team. You'll own the complete product design process, from research through implementation, shaping experiences that delight our users. This is a hands-on role where your work directly impacts our product roadmap and business outcomes.

Must-Haves
• Demonstrated end-to-end product design work with clear outcomes and measurable results
• Proficiency in Figma for design and prototyping
• Experience conducting user research with documented methodologies (interviews, surveys, usability testing, etc.)
• Portfolio with 2+ projects showing full product lifecycle from discovery through shipping
• Ability to articulate design decisions backed by research and user insights

Nice-to-Haves
• Experience with design systems and component libraries
• Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG)
• Background in B2B SaaS or fintech products
• Familiarity with analytics and data-driven design
• Experience mentoring junior designers
